first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus an explicit Belfast City 2006 dataset-specific binding between its 1 km archive/grid tile identifiers and the official coordinate reference system, together with readable archive-internal DTM tile filenames. This unused official OSNI Coverage Grid 10K window confirms that the published OSNI coverage grid provides the naming convention for DTM downloads and is referenced to the Irish Grid, but its tiles are 4.8 km x 3.2 km rather than the Belfast LiDAR 1 km archive tiles; the linked SpatialNI ArcGIS GeoService layer returned 502 Bad Gateway. Therefore Irish Grid is retained only as supporting OSNI DTM reference-system evidence and is not fabricated as a Belfast 2006 archive-specific CRS/tile binding.
